items.title: Composable Preview Driven Development with AI: TDD-fying your UI pAInlessly!
items.summary: So you're already familiar with Compose UI… but have you considered using AI alongside Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Composable Previews to supercharge how you build and refactor UI with confidence?Allow me to introduce you to “Composable Preview Driven Development”, a modern workflow where Previews, screenshot tests, and AI work hand in hand!In this tech talk, you will learn…- How planning your @Previews before AI generation leads to higher code quality- How to effortlessly turn @Previews into automated tests to reliably refactor UI- How AI and TDD work together to generate, refine, and evolve UI confidently- How TDD acts as a reliable guardrail for AI-generated UI, keeping it safe to refactor and evolveMake sure not to miss this opportunity to explore the powerful combination of AI, Test-Driven Development, and Composable Previews!No previous TDD knowledge is required!
